description: Dependency update policy for Trawl. Implements the ci-cd-pipeline capability.
Two gates decide an auto-merge, and both must agree: the deterministic gate
(cooldown elapsed, update class eligible, required checks green) and the agentic
triage check. The agent can only WITHHOLD the triage check; it can never make an
prBodyNotes: **Dependency gate.** This pull request is auto-merged only if the deterministic
classifier rules it eligible *and* the triage agent does not withhold. The agent
cannot promote an ineligible update; withholding is the only verdict it can return
that changes the outcome. See the `Dependency Gate` check for the record.

packageRules.description: Baseline: every ecosystem inherits the 3-day floor. Nothing is exempt, including patch releases and container image tags.
Higher-risk category 1 — direct runtime dependencies of the engine. 14 days.
Higher-risk category 2 — npm packages run at build time with install/postinstall script capability. 14 days.
SECURITY-RELEVANT — cryptography, authentication, signing. Always human review, never auto-merge, 14-day cooldown.
SECURITY-RELEVANT — the scanning and assessment tooling itself. A compromised scanner is a compromised estate. Always human review.
Major versions always route to a human, in every ecosystem, regardless of test results or agent opinion.
Container base images — same discipline as packages. Digest pinning so a moved tag is a visible diff.
Go toolchain and Go directive — human review; a toolchain bump changes every build.
GitHub Actions — pinned by digest, grouped, auto-mergeable once both gates agree.
Eligible for auto-merge: patch and minor updates not otherwise labelled. Still requires BOTH required checks to pass, one of which is the agentic triage check.
Pre-1.0 packages have no semver contract; a patch bump can break anything. Human review.
Go indirect dependencies — grouped to keep the dashboard legible; still gated identically.

description: Known-vulnerability fixes shorten the cooldown to 1 day but never to zero, and never
auto-merge. The tension is deliberate and documented: a shorter window trades
supply-chain detection time for exposure time. A human decides which risk is larger,
with the advisory in front of them.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
